title: RBI Penalty on Bank of Baroda for Fair Practices Code and KYC Violations
description: <cite index="28-4,28-5">Bank of Baroda was fined Rs. 63.6 lakh for non-compliance with provisions of the Fair Practices Code for Lenders and Know Your Customer (KYC) guidelines</cite>. <cite index="28-7">The regulator found that the public sector lender had charged interest above the contracted rate in certain loan accounts</cite>.
